ValidationRule.description: Prevents submitting a requisition with a target hiring date in the past.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Target_Hiring_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Target_Hiring_Date__c)), Target_Hiring_Date__c < TODAY() )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Target Hiring Date cannot be in the past when the requisition is submitted.
